assets.title: Tilted-Axis Classroom Globe
assets.description: One original static stylized desktop globe with a closed faceted spherical shell, simplified continent-shaped material regions on the same shell, a 23.5-degree tilted polar axis, two separate pole pins and genuinely bored bearing sleeves, a thick open meridian ring, short turned column and finite flat circular base. Eight named closed editable meshes form an actual interior-witness support chain from the globe to the base; the spherical surface has measured clearance from the meridian frame. The globe has its own centre pivot and explicit polar-axis direction. Only the supplied static orientation is checked; no rotation range or controller is promised. Metres, native Z up, ground-centre origin, front -Y. Five solid PBR materials, no textures, markings, labels or external assets. Simplified sea/land regions are visual illustration, not accurate geographic, navigation, astronomical or measurement data; no teaching outcome or product-safety claim.
